notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2PcSX7iinw

Set on Spica Island, enjoy the sights and sounds as you embark on a journey packed with 3D platforming action, adventure, and rhythm game boss fights!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/ea5cafad264aac0053fa8150484c26945a023871.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/311fa9b4c2a07e69510dbd7835c3e014fd0335a9.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/44215ecb8f1da94cfd33ee8e8323561db2b65a6f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a155b8b4391c3107f29bbf4588b444a20f1eabeb.jpg[/img]

Soundtrack also available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241210/Giraffe_and_Annika_Original_Sound_Track/

notes.title: As of today the Italian version of Alicemare is available to play!
notes.notes:
To play the Italian version:
[list]
    [*]Right-click the game in your Steam library > Properties > LANGUAGE > Select 'Italian' from the dropdown box
    [*]Note that if you have existing save data you must delete it first
    [*]To delete your data start the game > Right-click on the game in your Steam library > Properties > LOCAL FILES > BROWSE LOCAL FILES > Save > Delete the files in this folder. This must be done while the game is open and idling on the title screen
    [*]If your Windows Region setting is not set to "Italian (Italy)" you may experience text boxes overflow
    [*]To change your region open Control Panel > Region > Administrative Settings > Change System Locale > Select "Italian (Italy)" > OK > Restart Now
[/list]

Please enjoy your time with this sweet, ineffably cruel game once again -- in Italian.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/524850/Alicemare/

notes.title: Steam Sale! Celebrating the release of The Crooked Man!
notes.notes:
Today we have released "The Crooked Man" developed by Uri Games, the first installment in "The Strange Man" series. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/736570/The_Crooked_Man/

We are also planning to release the other titles in this series. 

To celebrate the launch of this title, we have set some fantastic 2D pixel games from Playism on sale! So please enjoy them all together. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/524850/Alicemare/

In addition, we would like to introduce the impressions from Miwashiba, the developer of Alicemare, about The Strange Man series.  

[quote]The Strange Man series offers up gripping horror vignettes of the highest caliber — among a gauntlet of other emotions, besides.
Horror games make me squeamish—I had to play this game from behind a pillow—but I was captivated into pushing through by the intriguing story and characters. I found myself caught in an endless cycle of wanting to move on, and being too afraid to do so.
I want for everyone to uncover what lies within for themselves; if you are in any way inclined, I urge you to play the series front to finish. Give the Strange Man series a chance to get its hook into you.
[/quote]

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 2/17
notes.notes:
Hi guys

We have just updated Alicemare's English version so that it is compatible with Chinese and Korean PCs. 

There should be no more crashes when launching the game. 

Hope you keep enjoying the game. 


For more updates on what we are doing, be sure to follow the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/playism]Playism Group on Steam![/url]
